title: Set 102

sentences.ko: 3월에 지금 집 계약이 끝나는데, 시내 반대편에 400달러 더 싼 집이 있어. 근데 거기로 가면 언니네랑 40분 거리가 돼. 내가 여기로 이사 온 이유가 언니 하나인데. 그래서 계속 뭐가 나은지 적어 보는데 매번 똑같이 비겨. 너라면 어떡할래?
sentences.text: My lease is up in March, and the place across town is four hundred cheaper, but it would put me forty minutes from my sister, and she's the whole reason I moved here in the first place. So I keep making a list and it keeps coming out even. What would you do?

alts.text: I've got until March on my lease, and there's a place across town for four hundred less, but it'd put me forty minutes from my sister, and she's the only reason I moved here at all. So I keep making a list and it keeps coming out a wash. What would you do?

My lease expires in March, and the apartment across town is four hundred less expensive, but it would place me forty minutes away from my sister, who is the entire reason I moved here to begin with. So I continue to make a list, and it continues to come out even. What would you do?

sentences.note: **in the first place** 는 애초에, 처음부터 그랬다는 뜻이다. **coming out even** 은 따져 봐도 양쪽이 비슷해서 우열이 안 갈린다는 말이다.

sentences.ko: 재밌는 거 보고 싶다며. 그래 놓고 내가 튼 재밌는 거 네 개를 다 퇴짜 놨잖아. 그러니까 네가 진짜 원하는 건 재밌는 게 아닌 것 같은데. 그냥 뭐가 당기는지 말해. 내가 찾아 줄게. 아니면 요리 프로 튼다. 넌 맨날 그러듯이 요리 프로 보다가 잠들면 되고.
sentences.text: You said you wanted something funny, and then you shot down the last four funny things I put on, so I don't think funny is actually what you want. Just tell me what you're in the mood for and I'll find it. Otherwise I'm putting on the cooking one, and you can fall asleep to that like you do every single time.

alts.text: Okay, you asked for something funny, and then you said no to the last four funny things I put on, so funny isn't really what you want. Just tell me what you're in the mood for and I'll go find it. Otherwise I'm throwing on the cooking one, and you can pass out to that like you do every single time.

You said that you wanted something funny, and then you rejected the last four funny things I put on, so I do not believe funny is what you actually want. Please tell me what you are in the mood for and I will find it. Otherwise I will put on the cooking one, and you may fall asleep to that as you do every single time.

sentences.note: **shot down** 은 남이 내놓은 것을 딱 잘라 거절했다는 뜻이다. **what you're in the mood for** 는 지금 뭐가 당기는지를 물을 때 쓰는 말이다.

sentences.ko: 옷도 다 갈아입고 신발까지 신었는데, 현관에서 옆집 사람한테 붙잡혀서 자기 차 얘기를 20분이나 들었어. 겨우 빠져나왔을 땐 수업이 벌써 시작했더라고. 사람들 다 앉아 있는 데로 늦게 들어가는 건 못 해. 그래서 그냥 다시 올라와서 저녁 해 먹었어.
sentences.text: I was already changed and had my shoes on, and then my neighbor caught me at the door and talked at me for twenty minutes about his car. By the time I got out of there the class had already started, and I'm not walking in late in front of that whole room. So I came back up and made dinner instead.

alts.text: Shoes were on, I was ready to walk out, and then my neighbor grabbed me at the door and went on about his car for twenty minutes. By the time I got away the class had already started, and no way am I walking in late in front of that whole room. So I came back up and made dinner instead.

I had already changed and put on my shoes, and then my neighbor stopped me at the door and talked at me for twenty minutes about his car. By the time I got away, the class had already begun, and I am not willing to walk in late in front of that entire room. So I came back upstairs and made dinner instead.

sentences.note: **talked at me** 는 주고받은 게 아니라 한쪽이 일방적으로 말을 쏟아냈다는 뜻이다. **By the time** 은 내가 그렇게 했을 무렵에는 이미 상황이 끝나 있었다는 말이다.
sentences.situation: 운동 가려다 말게 된 핑계 대기

sentences.ko: 저기요, 다른 사람 주문이 온 것 같아요. 봉투에 제 이름은 적혀 있는데 안에는 전부 샌드위치예요. 저는 치킨 플레이트를 시켰거든요. 어디선가 봉투 두 개가 서로 바뀐 것 같아요. 너무 배가 고파서 하나는 이미 반을 먹었어요. 안 먹은 척은 안 할게요. 차액만 환불해 주실 수 있을까요?
sentences.text: Hey, I think you guys gave me somebody else's order. The bag has my name on it, but it's all sandwiches and I ordered the chicken plate, so I'm guessing two bags got switched somewhere. I already ate half of one because I was starving, so I'm not going to pretend I didn't. Can you just refund me the difference?

alts.text: So I'm pretty sure I got somebody else's order. My name's on the bag, but it's all sandwiches and I ordered the chicken plate, so I'm guessing two bags got swapped somewhere. I already ate half of one because I was starving, so I'm not gonna act like I didn't. Can you just refund me the difference?

Excuse me, I believe I was given someone else's order. The bag has my name on it, but it contains only sandwiches, and I ordered the chicken plate, so I assume two bags were switched somewhere. I already ate half of one because I was very hungry, so I will not pretend that I did not. Could you please refund me the difference?

sentences.note: **got switched** 는 어디선가 두 개가 서로 뒤바뀌었다는 뜻이다. **refund me the difference** 는 값 차이만큼만 돌려 달라고 할 때 쓰는 말이다.
sentences.situation: 배달 시켰는데 엉뚱한 게 와서 얘기하기

sentences.ko: 정말 죄송해요. 자면서 저도 모르게 알람을 꺼 버렸어요. 진짜 이런 적이 한 번도 없어서 둘러댈 말도 없네요. 게다가 오는 길에 신호란 신호는 다 걸렸고요. 차가 막혔다고 할 수도 있지만 저랑 같은 길로 오시잖아요. 바로 아실 거예요.
sentences.text: I'm really sorry, I turned my alarm off in my sleep, which I've honestly never done before, so I don't even have a good story for you. And then I hit every light coming in. I could tell you it was traffic, but you come in the same way I do, so you'd know.

alts.text: Ugh, sorry. Apparently I shut the alarm off in my sleep, which I swear has never happened before, so I've got nothing good for you. And then I caught every light on the way in. I could say traffic, but you come in the same way I do, so you'd know.

I sincerely apologize. I turned off my alarm in my sleep, which I have honestly never done before, so I do not even have a good story for you. And then I caught every light on the way in. I could tell you that it was traffic, but you come in the same way I do, so you would know.

sentences.note: **hit every light** 는 오는 내내 신호마다 다 걸렸다는 뜻이다. **I don't even have a good story for you** 는 그럴듯하게 둘러댈 핑계조차 없다는 말이다.

reviewed: 1번 casual 의 "coming out a tie" 는 원어민이 이 자리에서 쓰는 말이 아니라 "coming out a wash" 로 바꿨다 (따져 보니 양쪽이 상쇄된다는 뜻).
1번 한국어 "이유가 통째로 언니인데" 가 번역투라 "이유가 언니 하나인데" 로 고쳤다.
2번 casual 의 "you killed the last four funny things" 는 kill 이 계획·기획을 접을 때 쓰는 말이라 제안을 퇴짜 놓는 자리에 안 맞는다. "you said no to" 로 바꿨다.
5번 casual 이 text 와 앞부분(I'm sorry, I ... my alarm off in my sleep)이 거의 그대로 겹쳐서 더 짧고 구어다운 말로 다시 썼다.
